blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 47-year-old e-bike rider was hit and crushed to death by a truck in San Pablo City, Laguna, on Monday night ,according to the local police. The e-bike rider stopped in front of the truck in Barangay San Roque at 10:50 p.m., based on security camera footage, the Calabarzon police said. The truck driver apparently failed to notice the e-bike in front of his vehicle and bumped it. The impact threw the rider onto the road and was later run over by the truck.
